problem.title: Why Do We Need Transparency?
problem.subtitle: Without transparency, it is difficult to ensure public funds are managed properly

cards.title: Hard to Monitor
cards.description: Citizens do not know where their tax money goes. Budget data is difficult to access and understand.
cards.statLabel: of citizens distrust national budget management

cards.title: Vulnerable to Manipulation
cards.description: Data in legacy systems can be altered without a trace. Reports can be falsified and revised at will.

cards.title: Delayed Audits
cards.description: Problems are only discovered months later — too late to prevent financial losses.

solution.title: The Solution: Blockchain for Transparency
solution.subtitle: Blockchain technology acts like a {notary} that no one can erase or alter

pillars.title: Immutable
pillars.subtitle: (Immutable)
pillars.description: Every recorded transaction cannot be edited, deleted, or manipulated. Like writing carved in stone.
pillars.analogy: Like a notary stamp that cannot be erased

pillars.title: Verifiable by Anyone
pillars.subtitle: (Transparent)
pillars.description: Anyone can inspect the raw data on the blockchain. No need to trust a single party — the data can be checked independently.
pillars.analogy: Like a cash ledger visible to everyone

pillars.title: Real-Time
pillars.subtitle: (Instant)
pillars.description: Data is updated immediately when a transaction occurs. No waiting for end-of-month reports or annual audits.

systemInsights.title: System Insights
systemInsights.subtitle: Under the hood: Database (Off-Chain) vs Blockchain (On-Chain)
howItWorksSteps: Draft → Database: Ministry creates project (stored in PostgreSQL, fast & searchable)
Publish → Blockchain: Ministry signs transaction, project immutably recorded on Solana
Database ← Blockchain: We store PDA address and tx signature in DB for quick lookups
Citizen Verifies: Click "View on Explorer" to verify DB data matches blockchain truth

With expertise in Rust, Anchor, TypeScript, and Next.js, he builds production-ready decentralised applications that prioritise user experience and real-world impact. OpenBudget.ID represents his commitment to leveraging blockchain technology for social good and government transparency.
